in_sanskrit.name: Parnita
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Daughter of the wind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Parnita एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, Parnita translates to ‘daughter of the wind’. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘parna’ which means ‘leaf’ and ‘ita’ which means ‘this’ or ‘that’. Parnita is often associated with the goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva. According to Hindu mythology, Parvati created Lord Ganesha, the elephant-headed god, as her protector and companion.
